verdict.rationale: ADK is a framework, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair axis. The evidence does not show one. The docs describe ADK agents acting as MCP clients and give a how-to for developers to build their own MCP server wrapping ADK tools. That guide is a developer building block, not a first-party MCP server a user can connect to, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: How to build an MCP server that wraps ADK tools, making them accessible to any MCP client.
